article.en: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
article.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特是少有的相信古代神话的人之一。

article.en: He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
article.zh: 他刚在城里买下一所新房子，但自从搬进去后，就和汽车及车主们发生了摩擦。

article.en: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
article.zh: 当他夜里回到家时，总是发现有人把车停在他家大门外。

article.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
article.zh: 为此，他甚至一次也没能把自己的车开进车库。

article.en: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.
article.zh: 贾斯珀曾把几块‘禁止停车’的牌子挂在大门外边，但没有任何效果。

article.en: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.
article.zh: 现在他把一个丑陋的石雕头像放在了大门上边。

article.en: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
article.zh: 这是我见过的最丑陋的头像之一。

article.en: I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon.
article.zh: 我问他那是什么，他告诉我那是蛇发女怪美杜莎。

article.en: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
article.zh: 贾斯珀希望她把汽车和车主们都变成石头。

article.en: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
article.zh: 但到目前为止还没有一个变成石头呢！
